title: Zur Farbenlehre, Didaktischer Teil, Erste Abteilung: Physiologische Farben
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
edition_cited: Tübingen: Cotta, 1810, vol. 1; Bayerische Staatsbibliothek scan, archive.org 10857915bsb (Fraktur OCR)
locator_hints: Erste Abteilung, Physiologische Farben: IV 'Blendendes farbloses Bild' (Abklingen, the coloured decay of a dazzling afterimage), V 'Farbige Bilder', and the passages on light seen with closed eyes and pressure on the eye
summary: Goethe's first-person observations of physiological colours: the dazzling colourless image and its 'Abklingen' through a sequence of colours with eyes closed, coloured afterimages, and light seen in the dark eye or under pressure. Added at the user's request as the classic account of how a bright-source afterimage turns coloured, relevant to the mechanism of fire-kasina and candle trataka.
why_relevant: Primary first-person account of the colour sequence of positive afterimages, the mechanism behind afterimage-based light practices.
